card.text: Explore Unitas in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT 197 shape model
shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction, 49 ± 5 km volume-equivalent diameter. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative.

elevation.title: DAMIT 197 radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 24.5 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
